notes.title: NEW Boss Fight and Player Robo Rilla Skin!
notes.content:
[h1]Unlock the new Robo Rilla player skin by beating the Level 7 challenge![/h1]

TURN ON both [b]TIMER MODE[/b] and [b]SCORE COUNTER[/b] to try the challenge.

This is gonna be the beginning of the Challenge Rewards System and will be used to unlock future cosmetic rewards including weapon skins. 

Please post cosmetic suggestions on the official **Discord: https://discord.gg/kGvmy6mEyw**

You don't have to get the high score and best time on the same run. 
It's based on your best record. 
You can work on getting the score requirement (more than 1500) on one attempt. 
And on another attempt, go for the time requirement (finish before 35 seconds).
So you can work on each requirement one at a time. 
Of course you actually have to win the level for it to count.

BTW The Boss Fight is now available after you've beaten Level 12. (It's still in Phase 1 prototype)

Good luck!

notes.title: Sandbox Mode Live
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.81 NEW SANDBOX MODE[/h2]
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
-Added Sandbox Mode unlockable after Level 5
-Increased default Shotgun Range from 3m to 4m
-Made menu Skulls interactable with normal hand
-Made menu Skulls interactable with Chainsword
-Victory music no longer plays if Music is toggled off

Sandbox Mode is where experimental features suggested by the community are tested without affecting the main game. New features will be added in an ongoing basis and can include crazy ideas that may not be included in the main game but are fun to mess around with.
You can unlock Sandbox Mode by beating Arena Level 5
Certain features in Sandbox Mode will only be available after beating the Arena level they first appear in (i.e. flames can only be used in sandbox after beating Arena Level 6).

[h3]*WARNING*: Increasing enemy count will affect performance[/h3]
[h3]Current Sandbox Features[/h3]
1. Choose any amount of any type of enemy to spawn
2. Adjust shotgun range
3. Adjust shotgun reload time
4. Turn environmental hazards on or off (some are only unlockable after beating certain levels)
5. Unlimited player health
6. Unlimited fuel for Chainsword

You can suggest new features to be added in Sandbox Mode such as new enemy types, weapons, and abilities in the Discord server.
